title: 2026's biggest beauty apologies and fails: from Lady Gaga’s Haus Labs to Patrick Ta
summary: Beauty brands such as Lady Gaga’s Haus Labs, Patrick Ta Beauty, Bobbi Brown’s Jones Road Beauty, Neutrogena and Dyson have all had to issue statements after missteps in 2026. Here’s why…
